rule.desc: Low-memory threshold with idle and cursor probes
RAM and screen gates share abort branch
Checks hostname-call result for sandbox marker

if.query:
(call_expression
  function: [
    (subscript_expression object: (call_expression) @receiver
      index: (string (string_fragment) @method))
    (member_expression object: (call_expression) @receiver
      property: (property_identifier) @method)]
  arguments: (arguments (string (string_fragment) @marker))
  (#eq? @method "includes")
  (#eq? @marker "sandbox")
  (#match? @receiver "[\"']hostname[\"']")) @match
